name: pencarimovie-server
description: PencariMovie Server - Telegram file streamer and Stremio/Nuvio media addon

SERVER_TOKEN.description: 32-character static access token for public addon URLs (e.g. /<token>/manifest.json)

SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Password for web dashboard access on public deployments

PM_MAX_STREAMS.description: Concurrent /api/download bodies before 503 + Retry-After. The engine default is 0 (unlimited), which suits self-hosting; a PaaS with a short request timeout wants an explicit cap, because overflow past it dies on the router timeout (Heroku H12 at 30s) and returns an HTML error page instead of a retryable JSON 503.

BOT_TOKENS.description: Optional pool of Telegram bot tokens, comma/space/newline separated. Set this when running more than one instance: the bot pool file lives on each instance's own ephemeral disk, so a bot added in the dashboard is only used by the instance that stored it. With BOT_TOKENS every instance logs in all of them and downloads are spread across the pool.
